title: Reading the source
brief: You have a shell on the portal web server. Find how the login builds its database query and where the admin area keeps its notes.
hint.1: grep -r searches inside folders. Look for SELECT.
hint.2: grep -rn SELECT /var/www shows file and line number.
hint.3: The query glues user input into SQL. Then read /var/www/admin/notes.txt.
walkthrough: grep -rn SELECT /var/www, cat login.php, cat admin/notes.txt, submit.
debrief: The query concatenates what the user types straight into SQL. Typing admin'-- changes the query itself (SQL injection). Defenders: use parameterised queries, never build SQL with string concatenation. Untrusted input is also dangerous when a page prints it back as HTML (cross-site scripting, XSS): escape output on the way out.
objective.grep: Search the web root for SQL queries
